steps: Preheat the oven to 200 °C (400 °F) and line a large baking sheet with parchment paper.
Cut the eggplant and red bell pepper into 2 cm cubes; dice the onion and mince the garlic.
Toss the eggplant, red bell pepper, and onion with 30 ml of olive oil, turmeric, cumin, and salt on the baking sheet.
Roast for 22 to 25 minutes, until the eggplant is golden and tender.
Meanwhile, rinse the quinoa and combine with the vegetable broth in a medium saucepan over medium-high heat.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low, cover, and cook for 14 to 15 minutes, until liquid is absorbed.
Heat the remaining 15 ml of olive oil in a small pan over medium heat; cook the minced garlic for 1 minute.
Add the cooked chickpeas to the garlic pan and warm for 3 minutes, stirring.
Divide the quinoa into bowls; top with the roasted vegetables, chickpeas, and a drizzle of lemon juice.
Serve warm. Keeps refrigerated for 3 days; store components separately for best texture.
